sampling_check_as_reported.criterion: Pre-declared refinement criterion (stated before the coarse scan): fit a parabola through every triplet of three consecutive coarse grid points (60 deg spacing) whose middle point is a local extremum of the electronic energy. Add a refinement point (at most 2, separated by at least 15 deg, inside -180..180) only if for such a triplet (1) the parabola vertex lies more than 12 deg from the nearest computed grid point, (2) the parabola predicts more than 0.5 kJ/mol lowering relative to the middle computed point, and (3) the predicted vertex lies inside the scanned interval. Otherwise do not add points. The continue/stop decision itself is taken in the main decision loop after these coarse observations are returned.

random_seed_as_reported.note: Dihedral scan, input construction, parsing and analysis are deterministic and invoke no random number generator. The registered initial conformer was generated from SMILES during structure preparation and exposes no seed; the archived geometry is reused unchanged.
